property_summary: For any caller, a withdrawAll call should never result in a zero-value ETH transfer (i.e., emit an empty call), but the buggy version with `if (oCredit >= 0)` will perform a zero-value call when the caller has no credit.
change_summary: Replace the condition 'if (oCredit > 0)' with 'if (oCredit >= 0)' to always execute the withdrawal block even when credit is zero, causing an unnecessary call with zero value and altering gas/state interaction.
